title: Glowing Armor
description: Adds emissive textures for all armors.
body:
## [Full Emissive](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fullemissive),  [Glowing Trims](https://modrinth.com/mod/glowingtrims) and Discord
[Full Emissive](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fullemissive) includes glowing armor + a lot more emissive textures for tools, blocks, items, and entities.

DOWNLOAD [Glowing Trims](https://modrinth.com/mod/glowingtrims)  FOR 26.2 FOR THE BEST EXPERIENCE.

Join my [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/xyG2zPvpeC) for updates, bug reporting, suggesting, support, and more!

# Glowing Armor
## Dependencies
Requires [Optifine](https://optifine.net/downloads) or [Fabric](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/) + [Continuity](https://modrinth.com/mod/continuity), with [ETF](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures) and [EMF](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features/versions)
## Adds Emissive Textures to:
- All armor (player, horse, wolf, nautilus)
- Armor trims (for vanilla, without any shaders)
- For glowing armor trims with shaders and mods, download [Glowing Trims](https://modrinth.com/mod/glowingtrims)
  
![Emissive Armour](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a3735b4c89a6abdff5374adf57705c5ec8c5c288_0.webp)

## Recommendations

Emissive textures work best with Shaders! For better PCs I recommend using [Super Duper Vanilla](https://modrinth.com/project/LMIZZNxZ), and ensuring correct lighting settings are enabled. [Mellow](https://modrinth.com/shader/mellow) shaders also work really well for the lower end, really highlighting the emissive textures!
